top_violation_types.title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was lacking current transportation training. The operation provides transportation.

top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One of four  of the transportation vehicles did not have a first aid kit available for review.  The other 3 vehicles were missing or had expired supplies from the first aid kits that were added during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping with a bottle.

top_violation_types.title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping in a restrictive device.

top_violation_types.title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed swaddled in a blanket while being held by a caregiver.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children were observed watching mickey mouse during snack time    This was corrected during the inspection when I observed the caregiver turn off the tablet and closed it.

top_violation_types.title: Activities for Infants - Outdoor Play Daily (26 TAC §746.2417(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined that the younger infant classroom has not being going outside.
